config.split: same 80/10/10 winner-stratified game split as EXP-001R
config.purge: remove validation states seen in train; remove test states seen in train or retained validation

definition.state_weighted_preserve_each_record_targ: mean within-state record loss, then equal weight per unique state
definition.state_weighted_aggregated_target: one mean target and one prediction per unique state, equal weight per state

purged_holdout.split_method: original 80/10/10 winner-stratified game split, followed by exact-state purge
purged_holdout.warning: Purged metrics describe the existing checkpoint, which was trained on the original training games. The purged validation/test subsets are useful diagnostics of novel encoded states, but their small sample sizes and game-level selection must be considered. No retraining was performed.
